PRIMARY_ASSET_COLLISION_FAMILIES_AFTER: UNCHANGED - 2 families still present; NOT closed in this wave

families.cause: A cascade within stock CARLA Town11 world-partition content: Town11_Tile_* sublevels each register the SAME PrimaryAssetID 'Map:/Game/Carla/Maps/TestMaps/EmptyMap', so each new registration displaces the previous one. It is a registration-identity collision among sibling tiles, not a filename collision.
Town11's own map registers the BaseLargeMap PrimaryAssetID, colliding with the standalone /Game/Maps/BaseLargeMap/LargeMap asset.

evidence.conclusion: Every one of the 31 collisions is in stock CARLA Town11 / BaseLargeMap / TestMaps content. Zero involve /Game/Ingolstadt.

classification.relation_to_the_5711_building_issue: NONE - kept strictly separate as instructed. The building issue is a wrong-subpath serialized reference under /Game/Ingolstadt; these are PrimaryAssetID registration collisions under /Game/Maps. Different namespace, different mechanism, different fix.
classification.note_on_the_refuted_junction_hypothesis: The earlier junction hypothesis was already refuted for the building namespace and is NOT revived here. The Content/Carla junctions created in an earlier wave are a separate environment adaptation and are not implicated in these Town11 collisions.

why_not_closed_now: Both families live in CARLA's own stock content (Town11, BaseLargeMap, TestMaps). Changing them means either editing CARLA upstream assets or excluding Town11 from the cook, both of which alter engine/content state.

A UE workload is required to enumerate the full PrimaryAssetID registry and confirm closure, and launching UE4Editor-Cmd.exe while UE4Editor PID 5344 is running a cook is prohibited by the batch rules for this phase.
No evidence was found that these collisions affect the Ingolstadt map. They are logged warnings, not errors, and the cook proceeded past them to 82.7 percent completion.
recommended_closure_path_after_cook: Run a minimal AssetManager/AssetRegistry dump to enumerate every PrimaryAssetID and its registered paths, rather than relying on cook-time warnings which only surface collisions encountered in load order.
Confirm whether Town11 is required by the Ingolstadt cook at all. If Town11 is pulled in only as engine-default content, excluding it removes 30 of 31 warnings with no effect on Ingolstadt.
Treat BaseLargeMap/LargeMap separately: it is a single collision between two distinct assets and likely needs either an ID rename or an exclusion.
Do not silence the warnings. The requirement is a unique-ID state, not absence of logging.
not_claimed: No UE process was launched to enumerate the registry.
The judgement that these do not affect Ingolstadt is based on the absence of any /Game/Ingolstadt path in the collision set, not on a full registry dump.
